scope:
Incremental DNS TCP framing against a concatenated-byte reference.

Tests framing only; DNS payload syntax and transaction matching are separate.
limits: Pure framing only; no socket driver, DNS message validation, transaction dispatch or TCP retry/pooling implementation.
Empty payloads are representable at the framing layer; DNS message parsing must reject them as incomplete DNS messages.
The test fixture compares frame lengths and 32-bit rolling byte fingerprints against an independent concatenated-stream reference, rather than emitting every large payload byte.
The current dns-response single-question matcher is not yet the TCP-specific matcher: RFC 7766 section 7 permits replies without a question section.
